how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-northshire-valley-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6:obj:0: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:6:details:0: Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge. Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!
rows.quest:6:details:1: BBut be wary, ⟦1⟧. Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him. He will not be an easy man to reach.
rows.quest:6:completion:0: Hah - you caught him! You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
rows.quest:7:obj:0: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
rows.quest:7:details:0: Your first task is one of cleansing, ⟦2⟧. A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north. Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find. Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7:completion:0: Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of ⟦E2⟧ do not need another threat.
rows.quest:7:completion:1: BFor defeating them, you have my gratitude.
rows.quest:15:obj:0: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
rows.quest:15:details:0: ⟦3⟧, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought. A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.
rows.quest:15:details:1: BGo to the mine and remove them. We know there are at least 10. Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
rows.quest:15:completion:0: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
rows.quest:18:obj:0: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:18:details:0: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around ⟦E1⟧. They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.
rows.quest:18:details:1: BI don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good! Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
rows.quest:18:completion:0: Back with some bandanas, I see. The ⟦E2⟧ Army appreciates your help.
rows.quest:21:obj:0: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:21:details:0: Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging. Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.
rows.quest:21:details:1: BWaste no time, ⟦4⟧. The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:21:completion:0: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the ⟦E2⟧ Army. There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. We have further tasks for you.
rows.quest:33:obj:0: Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:33:details:0: I hate those nasty timber wolves! But I sure like eating wolf steaks... Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.
rows.quest:33:details:1: BTough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the ⟦E1⟧ countryside.
rows.quest:33:completion:0: You've been busy! I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...
rows.quest:33:completion:1: BI have some things here you want - take your pick!
rows.quest:54:obj:0: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:54:details:0: ⟦5⟧, you are a ⟦6⟧ with proven interest in the security of ⟦E1⟧. You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:54:details:1: BIf you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
rows.quest:54:completion:0: Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the ⟦E2⟧ Marshals. Congratulations.
rows.quest:54:completion:1: BAnd good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!
rows.quest:54:completion:2: BIt's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
rows.quest:783:details:0: I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young ⟦7⟧, because there is work to do here in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:783:details:2: BThe ⟦E2⟧ guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close. And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home. And their alliance.
rows.quest:783:details:3: BIf you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride. He's inside the abbey behind me.
rows.quest:783:completion:0: Ah, good. Another volunteer. We're getting a lot of you these days.
rows.quest:783:completion:2: BThe human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad. This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.
rows.quest:783:completion:3: BIt is a many-fronted battle we wage, ⟦8⟧. Gird yourself for a long campaign.
rows.quest:3903:details:0: You've shown yourself a dependable ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧. Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?
rows.quest:3903:details:1: BI have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble. She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable. I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
rows.quest:3903:completion:0: Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me? He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at ⟦E1⟧ Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.
rows.quest:3904:obj:0: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3904:details:0: A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the ⟦E1⟧ Vineyards while I was harvesting! I reported it to the ⟦E1⟧ guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes! If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.
rows.quest:3904:details:1: BPlease, you must help me! I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.
rows.quest:3904:details:2: BBring me those buckets! Save my harvest!
rows.quest:3904:completion:0: Oh thank you, ⟦11⟧! You saved my harvest! And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.
rows.quest:3904:completion:1: BWe might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
rows.quest:3905:obj:0: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3905:details:0: Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals. He manages the store of food and drink in ⟦E1⟧, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.
rows.quest:3905:details:1: BYou'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
rows.quest:3905:completion:1: BOh my! Milly's grapes have been saved! When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!
rows.quest:3905:completion:2: BAnd through your bravery, we now have grapes for more wine! May the Light bless you, ⟦12⟧, and keep you safe!
rows.quest:5261:details:0: Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him. That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in ⟦E1⟧ Valley lately.
rows.quest:5261:details:1: BIf you're interested then speak with Eagan. He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
rows.quest:5261:completion:0: That's true. I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves! Are you that person?
